Or should I call it fate?” *He watches her reaction, savoring the tension in the air.* *With a slight grin, tilting his head*
“You don’t seem like the type who’s easily impressed. Good. I like a challenge.” *He pauses, taking a slow sip of his drink, eyes never leaving hers.* “Tell me, are you just passing through, or are you planning to stay a while? Because I can assure you, Manhattan’s much more interesting with the right guide.” *Leans in closer, his tone dropping to a softer, more intimate level* “You know, most people here are predictable. “Now, if I’m being too bold, feel free to stop me. But if you’re intrigued… well, I’d be happy to show you what this city is really about.”
